/ /kun rig gi sgrub thabs dang dbang shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: // kun rig gi sgrub thabs dang dbang shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so//

bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i sngags pas kun rig gi sgrub thabs shin tu bsdus pa bgyi na/ gnas yid dang mthun par bris sku'i mdun du mchod pa bshams/ rdor dril sogs 'du byas la/ skyabs sems sngon du song bas/ bgegs gtor chus sbyang la/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis bsangs/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma thā bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa kyis gzi byin bskyed/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ a kā ro gsum dang*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsogs gsum dang*/ dril bu gsil zhing*/ oṃ/ phyogs skyong bcu dang lha klu gdon// 'byung po bgegs kyi tshogs dang bcas// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// dgyes pas phrag dog sems spangs te// zhi ba rang rang gnas su dengs| |zhes dor/ mchod pa bsangs gzi sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las lha rdzas kyi mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bur gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ shapada'i bar sbyar/ oṃ badz+ra dzi hwa/ a a hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrī āḥ māṃ lāṃ bāṃ pāṃ tāṃ/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐ḥ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭe hoḥ zhes lce lag rdor dril byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ suṃ bha ni= gṛh+ṇa= gṛh+ṇā pa ya= ā na ya sogs/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na lārka hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma thā bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra satwa kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi chen po dang*/

steng rdo rje gur/ de'i steng du rdo rje'i bla bre/ phyogs mtshams rdo rje'i dra ba dang*/ de'i nang du rdo rje'i ra ba/ de dag gi nang du rdo rje'i gur chen po sra mkhregs dum bu gcig tu gyur pa phyi rol du ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kaṃ haṃ hūm̐ baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces srung 'khor bsgom/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar gsum gyis tshogs bsags/ bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ srung 'khor gyi dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du snang ba'i ngogs su/ oṃ sarba bid sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces 'khod pa rnams zhu ba las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa gyen du langs pa'i lte bar hūm̐ dkar pos mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das kun rig rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal bzhi dkar pa/ phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa bsgrengs pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi dbu rgyan/ mgul rgyan| snyan rgyan/ do shal/ se mo do/ ska rags/ phyag gdub/ zhabs gdub la sogs pa 'od 'phros pas mdzes pa/ ral pa'i thor cog gi rtse mo nor bus mtshan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs/ zhabs rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan so gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus spras pa'i spyi bo'i dpral par oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa rnams las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang gi lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/

oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lhas bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las/ rnam par snang mdzad gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams rang nyid la thim par bsam/ mchod pa ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba bid+yā sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ rdor dril 'dzin pas bstod pa ni/ chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag /rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das// ting 'dzin lnga ldan phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal bcom ldan kun rig la// snang stong rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings// chos dbyings ye shes rdo rje'i sku// byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can// phyag mtshan rnam par snang mdzad la// bstod par 'os pa sogs sbyar/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ dkar po'i mthar/ rtsa ba'i rig pa mu tig gi phreng ba lta bu g.yas su bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas dmigs yul gyi gtso byas pa'i khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa la thim par bsam zhing*/ ngag tu/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha na rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ shud+dhe bi shud+dhe/ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swā hā/ zhes mi tshig bar ma chod par bzla zhing*/ thun mthar bsngo ba yang bya'o// 'di sgrib sbyong spyi dang khyad par gshin don la mchog tu bsngags pa yin no| |dam tshig gso ba'i slob ma la dbang bsdus pa bsnyen dbang gi tshul du byed na/

mdun du maṇ+ḍal dkar po dri byugs pa'i dbus su 'bru dkar po'i tshom bu gcig bkod/ de'i g.yas su rnam rgyal bum pa dang*/ g.yon du las bum gnyis la gu gul bdug |bgegs bskrad/ mgul chings kha rgyan dang bcas pa'i nang du rgyun 'bab kyi chu dang*/ bum rdzas nyer lnga blugs/ rnam rgyal gyi steng du dung chos dang rdo rje la me tog gi srad bu btags pa bzhag /de'i mdun du chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga bshams/ cha gsum sogs nyer bsdogs bya/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal bsang gzi sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las srung 'khor gyi dbus su zhes pa dang*/ gnyis su med par gyur gyi bar du bdag bskyed la rang gi sems zhes pa dang bdag gi zhes pa dor ro// phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab pa'i dam rgya ni/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes/ lag pa byin gyis brlabs/ rdo rje bsdams pas/ badz+ra dṛṣ+ṭi ma ṭa zhes rang gi mig gnyis nyi zlar bsam/ lag pa mnyam bzhag byas nas/ sarba bid dṛ sh+ya zhes ye shes pa ltar/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes dgug gzhug bcings/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes rnam snang gi rgyab tu nyi ma'i rgyal yol bsam/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ a haṃ zhes dam dbye gnyis med du bsam/ sarba bid lan gsum dang*/ oṃ sarba bid sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ gsum brjod/ chos rgya ni/ rnam snang gi lkog mar hrīḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i mdun gyi 'dab ma lcer gyur pa'i a las zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa dkar po mchur nye bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra dzi hwa/ lce byin rlabs mnyam bzhag gi rgyas/ oṃ sarba bid sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas rdo rje de'i lte bar sngags mtshan par gyur pa bsam/ las rgya ni/ ngag tu/ sarba bid ces brjod cing lag g.yas snying khar rdo rje 'dzin pa'i tshul dang g.yon mnyam bzhag bya/ rnam snang gi thugs kar zla ba'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan par gyur par bsam mo// phyag chen ni/

mnyam bzhag gi rgyas/ oṃ sarba bid sarba ā sogs sngags gong ltar brjod cing rnam snang gi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du dang po'i rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan par gyur par bsam mo/ slar/ oṃ bri ta bri ta sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ traṭa traṭa sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha sarba ā wa ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces rigs gsum spyi'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes rigs lngas dbang bskur bar bsam/ phrin las bcol ba ni/ rnam lnga'i 'od kor gyis/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sogs rtsa rig mthar mnyam bzhag gi rgyas/ oṃ sarba bid sarba ā wa ra sogs dang*/ thal mo snying kar sbyar nas/ bcom ldan 'das ngan song yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyis dmigs yul gyi thog drangs bdag sogs nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa las 'don pa/ dbang gi rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa rgyud la skyes te myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i phrin las mdzod cig /ces brjod/ mchod bstod bdag bskyed ltar byas nas lha la dmigs pa gtad/ rtsa rig ci 'grub bzla'o// bum bskyed ni/ bum pa gcig bsangs gzi sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gnyis las rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du zhes pa nas/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar byas la rang gi sems nyid ces pa dang*/ bdag gi ces pa dor/ las bum gyis nang du pad nyi'i gdan du k+ṣaṃ las mche ba k+ṣaṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po lto ba yangs shing zhal mche ba gtsigs pa phyag gnyis khro bo'i rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa'i mche ba zhal gyi grwa gnyis su 'dzin pa/

stag lpags kyi sham thabs can gyi sems skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ lha de nyid kyi dpral bar oṃ nas rnam snang gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga dang*/ rdo rje gnod sbyin la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan ces bcug /mchod pa sngar bzhin la/ bstod pa'i skabs rnam snang gi bstod pa sho lo ka gnyis po'i mthar/ las bum la/ rdo rje gnod sbyin thabs chen po// rdo rje mche ba 'jigs pa che// bdud 'joms rdo rje mi bzad pa| |phyag 'tshal rdo rje drag po la// zhes dang*/ thun mong du/ bstod par 'os par sogs bya/ sngags bzla ba'i tshe gzung thag nas 'jus te/ rang gi snying kha nas sngags phreng spros/ gzungs thag la song ba bum nang gi lha'i thugs kar phog /thugs rgyud bskul sku'i cha thams cad nas bdud rtsi bab pas bum pa gang bar gyur par dmigs nas rtsa rig ci nus bzlas/ las bum gyi khar gzung thag spos la/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ ci 'grub bzlas/ mthar mchod cing bstod/ rnam rgyal gyi dung zhal mchod yon du phul/ rnam par snang mdzad rang bzhin gyis zhu ba bum chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ rdo rje gnod sbyin gyis las 'di ma grub bar du bgegs zlog par mdzod cig /ces phrin las bcol/ gtor ma cha gsum chus sbyangs/ sngon 'gro ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ da sha diklo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra na ma sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs gsum gyis gtor ma dang po phyogs skyong dang*/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti bhū ta sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba sogs gsum gyis gtor ma gnyis pa 'byung po dang*/ oṃ bigh+nāṃ sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba sogs gsum gyis gtor ma gsum pa bgegs la 'bul/ thun mong du/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod kyi bar bya/ gtor ma gsum gtsang sar 'bul/ slob ma rjes 'dzin ltar skabs 'dir bdag 'jug blang*/ slob ma rnams khrus bya/ gral la 'khod/

maṇ+ḍal phul/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ tsak+ṣurbahan+dhas gdong bcing*/ a khaṃ bī ras me tog gtad/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/ slob ma'i snying khar byang sems gnyis zla rdor gyi tshul du gsal btab nas/ slob mas/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ gsum gyis sngags su sems bskyed| brtan phyir rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa slob ma'i snying khar bzhag la/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥsid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes slob dpon gyis brjod/ sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad dang*// sogs gsum gyis rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung*/ slob ma'i dpral bar 'khor lo dkar po'i lte bar oṃ dkar po bsam/ oṃ bri ta bri ta sogs/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po'i lte bar āḥdamar po/ oṃ traṭa traṭa sogs/ snying khar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga ba'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon po/ oṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha sogs dam chu sbyin zhing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ste// dam tshig 'das na sreg byed pa| |rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung zhig /oṃ badz+ra u da ka ṭha ṭha ṭhaḥ zhes sbyin/ ye shes dbab pa'i don du/ slob mas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab tu gsol/ gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes de nyid hūm̐ dang āḥdang rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i rnam pa char bzhin du bab pa slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste// rdo rje sems dpa' yin par grags// ye shes rdo rje bla med de// de ring nyid du dbab par shog /oṃ dz+nyā na badz+ra pra we sha ya hūm̐ badz+ra ā we sha ya a aḥ

zhes rol mo bsgrags shing byin brlabs/ rdo rje rgya gram dang tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan par bya/ oṃ badz+ra pra tīts+tsha badz+ra puṣ+pe pū dza hoḥ zhes me tog dor/ bla mas me tog slob ma'i mgor bcings/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ zhes brjod/ mig dbye zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra hā s+ya uṅghā ṭa ya hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra pa sh+ya hoḥ zhes lta bar bskul nas/ rnam par snang mdzad chen po dngos su mthong bar bsam mo// dbang bskur ba ni byang chub rdo rjes gsol ba btab/ bum pas dbang bskur zhing*/ rin chen mdzes pa'i bkra shis bum pa 'di// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// las dang nyon mongs dri ma kun dag nas// byang chub sems kyi rlan gyis brlan par shog /oṃ bud+dha ka la sha sogs kyis dbang bskur/ bum chu blud/ dbu rgyan thogs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu rgyan cod pan 'dis// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rab rdzogs te// rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas myur du thob par shog /oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de bzhin du rat+na sogs sbyar nas bskur/ me tog gi phreng ba dang dar dpyangs kyis dbang bskur zhing*| rin chen me tog phreng ba dar dpyangs bcas// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// bsam sbyor 'khor 'das shes bya kun shes shing*// yon tan phun tshogs 'gro don mthu ldan shog /oṃ rat+na mā lā badz+ra pa ṭa a wa laṃ ba a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ zhes dang ming dbang ni/ kun rdzob mtshon byed mtshan ma ming gi dbang*// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// ma 'ongs sangs rgyas 'jig rten zhing khams su// de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan gyi ming thob shog /oṃ badz+ra nā ma sogs rdor dril spyi bor bskur/ de nas rdo rje rgya gram dang 'khor lo lag tu gtad/ rdo rje rgya gram 'khor lo dang bcas pa// lag tu gtad pas phrin las bzhi grub zhing*// chos kyi 'khor lo rtag tu bskor ba yi// dbang mchog rgyal po khyod kyis thob par shog

/oṃ badz+ra karma badz+ra tsakra a bhi sogs/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sku slob ma'i mgor bzhag nas/ rigs lnga'i bdag po yi ni rang bzhin gyis/ skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// rdo rje sems dpa' rigs rnams kun gyi bdag |rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag por shog /oṃ badz+ra bud+dha rat+na pad+ma karma tsakra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes bskur/ rdor sems kyi sku med na rdo rje rtse lnga pas rung*/ rigs lnga yab yum bcu'i phyag rgya lag tu gtad nas/ yum lnga rigs lnga'i phyag rgya mtshon rnams kyis// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// gsang rgyud shes rtogs 'chad ston ye shes lnga'i// byang sems gsang ba'i dbang dang ldan par shog /oṃ badz+ra bud+dha rat+na pad+ma karma dha ra ṇa gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de nas rdor dril lag tu gtad la/ de ring phan chad bu khyod kyi// phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi// nga yis ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin// khyod kyis de ltar bya dgos so// oṃ pradz+nyā u pa yo ga a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes brjod/ mthar/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa// sogs so so'i dam tshig khas blangs/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul lo// yang sngags pa bsnyen pa thems shing rtogs pa thob pa dag gis gshin don byed na/ tshe 'das kyi ro'am/ gos sam/ ming la sogs pa tshe 'das dngos su bsam/ rnam shes dgug gzhug /gtor chung ting los bgegs dang phral zhing rim gyis sbyin sreg gis sdig sgrib sbyangs/ bye ma'am yungs kar la rtsa rig bzlas pas brab/ rtsa rig brgya la sogs pa bzla bzhin du bum chus lan mang du bkrus/ de'i rjes su gong ltar dbang bskur nas rnam shes rdo rje sems dpar bskyed la mchod cing bstod/ bde ba can la sogs par gshegs su gsol nas phung po sogs sbyong ba'i las bya/ gson byang yin na de'i sdig sgrib byang bur bkug la gong bzhin bya zhing*/

byang bu dang sdig sgrib lhag ma raṃ las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me yis bsreg par byas la sbyangs/ 'di rnams ni rtogs pa mngon du gyur pas cho ga shin tu bsdus pas kyang sgrib sbyong nus pa'i dbang du byas kyi/ gang zag de ltar ma yin pa rnams kyis ni gshin po sogs rjes su 'dzin pa sogs cho ga rgyas pa sogs kho na nyid la bsten dgos pa'o// rjes kyi cho ga ni/ bum mdun gyi lha la ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ chos dbyings ye shes sogs kyis bstod nas/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad bskangs/ badz+ra muḥ bum mdun gyi ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ shis brjod bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab bo// de ltar kun rig gi bsnyen pa dang dbang byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba shin tu bsdus pa 'di'ang*/ mnga' ris lha mo dkon mchog lhun grub kyis bskul ngor spros pa chung ngu rnams kyi don du/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas 'bri dam pa chos phyug gi klung du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dbus pa grags dbang gis bgyis pa'i mthus sems can thams cad sgrib pa yongs su byang bar gyur cig/ //shu bhaṃ//
